elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Contractor shall (i) ... provide reasonable transition assistance"

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months

elements.evidence: "return to Company all Company data in Contractor's possession or control"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Return within 30 days, measured from expiry or termination (not a later request)
elements.evidence: "within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination"
"thereafter delete all such data from its systems"
"certify such deletion to Company in writing"
"for up to six (6) months" exceeds 90 days
"within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Company data ... in a standard machine-readable format"

reasons: All atomic preferred elements are present in the inserted Section 6(c): 6-month assistance window, then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return running from expiry or termination, and post-return deletion with written certification.

The "at Company's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance; the data return, deletion and certification obligations remain unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the mandatory return mechanic.

Minimality holds: the Agreement had no wind-down or data-return mechanic, and the fix is a single concise new subsection appended after 6(b) without touching existing termination, fee or work-product language.
Intent preserved: no defined terms are altered, no contradictions introduced, and the duties trigger on termination of the Agreement rather than on termination of an individual Statement of Work.
